question: Where is Idris mentioned in the Quran?
answer: Idris is mentioned in 1 ayahs of the Quran.
name: Idris

evidence.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ إِدۡرِيسَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقٗا نَّبِيّٗا
evidence.en: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
evidence.de: Und gedenke im Buch Idris’. Er war ein Wahrhaftiger und Prophet.
